name: OP_CAT
summary: Re-enables the OP_CAT opcode for string concatenation on the stack. Combined with existing opcodes, this enables powerful new scripting capabilities including BitVM, state channels, and advanced covenants.
summaryZh: 重新启用 OP_CAT 操作码进行栈上字符串连接。与现有操作码结合，支持强大的新脚本功能，包括 BitVM、状态通道和高级契约。
